title: Ur2yung [V2]
status_source_term: Beat Only | Beat Only | CD Quality
description: According to Machinedrum, "Ur2Yung was originally going to be on Vapor City back in 2013, but Kanye wanted it for Yeezus so I held back on releasing it until this year. #AViewOfU". He would also state that he tweeted "just got the craziest news, cant wait to share" some time in 2012, referring to the news that Kanye wanted the song, however he most likely meant 2013 as the timeline doesn't match up. Most likely pre-Rick Rubin, as he was the last producer to work on the album in the last 15 days of production. The instrumental of this version is slightly different to the released instrumental. Later released on A View Of U in 2020. The 2013 version of the instrumental, which is possibly what Ye recorded on, leaked on August 18th 2026.
